finalists.label: Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST)
finalists.why: It has specific evidence for a submucosal lesion and ulceration of the overlying mucosa.

finalists.label: Lipoma
finalists.why: It has a submucosal lesion and no evidence against it, with fat attenuation in the CT scan supporting this diagnosis.

finalists.label: Gastric carcinoid tumor
finalists.why: It explains the submucosal lesion, but lacks specific evidence compared to other finalists.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of fat attenuation in the antropyloric region on the CT scan specifically supports the diagnosis of Lipoma.
